lines.zh: 我跟着前面那条鳀鱼的尾巴游。
lines.en: I swim in the wake of the fish ahead.

lines.zh: 六条同伴一起转弯，海面闪了一下。
lines.en: Six of us turn at once and the water flashes.

lines.zh: 我的身体只有你两指宽。
lines.en: My whole body is two fingers wide.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，阳光就在背上。
lines.en: I skim the surface with sunlight on my back.

lines.zh: 鱼群散开又合拢，像一块会动的影子。
lines.en: The school splits and closes like a moving shadow.

lines.zh: 我游得很快，方向却由大家一起定。
lines.en: I swim fast, but the school decides where.

lines.zh: 一条海草挡路，我从它上面滑过去。
lines.en: A kelp stalk blocks me, so I slip over it.

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚的缝隙里穿来穿去。
lines.en: I thread through the gaps in the coral.

lines.zh: 上面的鱼动了，我就跟着动。
lines.en: When the fish above moves, I move.

lines.zh: 这么浅的水，我一眼就看得清。
lines.en: In water this shallow I see everything clearly.

lines.zh: 我把队形折成一道弯弯的银线。
lines.en: I bend the school into a curved silver line.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼游过，海底就亮了一条缝。
lines.en: A shoal passes and a seam of light opens.

lines.zh: 我不领路，我只跟着领路的游。
lines.en: I do not lead; I follow the one who leads.

lines.zh: 每次摆尾，我都离同伴更近一点。
lines.en: Every flick of my tail brings me closer to them.

lines.zh: 我跟着鱼群画一个圈，圈又合上。
lines.en: I trace a circle with the school, and it closes again.

lines.zh: 银光一闪，我们换了个方向。
lines.en: A flash of silver, and we change direction.

lines.zh: 我贴着同伴的侧腹游，省力。
lines.en: I swim close to a companion's flank, saving strength.

lines.zh: 水面上有船影，我们沉了半格。
lines.en: A boat shadow passes; we sink half a block.

lines.zh: 海草向右倒，我们就往右拐。
lines.en: The kelp leans right, so we turn right.

lines.zh: 我们六条一起摆尾，水就乱了。
lines.en: Six of us sweep at once and the water ripples.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，让水流替我动。
lines.en: I hold still and let the current do the moving.

lines.zh: 嘴里含着一口水，慢慢吐出去。
lines.en: I hold a mouthful of water, then let it go.

lines.zh: 我们六条一起悬着，谁都不说话。
lines.en: All six of us hover, and none of us speaks.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水面，在我鳞上碎成小点。
lines.en: Sunlight breaks through the surface into flecks on my scales.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让鳃盖一张一合。
lines.en: I tilt sideways and let my gill cover work.

lines.zh: 水草在动，我盯着它看了很久。
lines.en: The weed sways, and I watch it a long while.

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，只是不掉队。
lines.en: I do nothing except keep my place.

lines.zh: 有东西从上面漂过，我没抬头。
lines.en: Something drifts overhead; I do not look up.

lines.zh: 同伴都停着，我也跟着停。
lines.en: My school has stopped, so I stop too.

lines.zh: 海水咸得发苦，我早已习惯。
lines.en: The sea tastes bitter with salt; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收起来，像一片小叶子。
lines.en: I fold my fins and become a small leaf.

lines.zh: 深深的蓝在我四周慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: The deep blue settles slowly around me.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚影子里，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang in the coral's shadow without moving.

lines.zh: 水面在下雨，我听见闷闷的响。
lines.en: Rain hits the surface, a muffled drum above me.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我抬头看了你一眼。
lines.en: You stand on the shore, and I glance up.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，比鱼群还大。
lines.en: Your shadow falls in, larger than my whole school.

lines.zh: 你拿着桶，我认得那种东西。
lines.en: You carry a bucket, and I know that shape.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，又退回鱼群里。
lines.en: I circle half around you, then retreat to the school.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也就不动。
lines.en: You stay still, so I stay still.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看你，你被拉得又高又长。
lines.en: Through the water you look tall and stretched.

lines.zh: 那群人都怕我，你却蹲下来了。
lines.en: The others fear me, but you crouch down.

lines.zh: 我猜你不是海鸟，海鸟不会站着。
lines.en: You are no seabird; seabirds do not stand.

lines.zh: 你把网收起来了，我松了口气。
lines.en: You put the net away, and I relax a little.

lines.zh: 我只看了你一秒，就跟着同伴走了。
lines.en: I look at you a second, then follow the school.

lines.zh: 我被戳了一下，整群都散了。
lines.en: Something pokes me and the whole school scatters.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，你别碰我。
lines.en: I have a single point of health; do not touch me.

lines.zh: 疼！我窜进了珊瑚的缝里。
lines.en: It hurts! I dart into a crack in the coral.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了一小片。
lines.en: I have lost a small patch of scales.

lines.zh: 水一下变红了，我拼命游。
lines.en: The water turns red and I swim with all my strength.

lines.zh: 谁在打我？我什么都没做。
lines.en: Who is hitting me? I have done nothing.

lines.zh: 我往深处钻，越深越好。
lines.en: I dive deeper, the deeper the better.

lines.zh: 这一点伤，对我就够重了。
lines.en: A wound this small is already heavy for me.

lines.zh: 同伴四散，我也跟着乱窜。
lines.en: My school scatters and I dart wildly too.

lines.zh: 你把我打成这样，鱼汤都不够。
lines.en: Beat me like this and there is not even soup.

lines.zh: 是鱼食吗？那味道从水面飘下来。
lines.en: Is that fish food? The smell drifts down.

lines.zh: 我往上凑了一点，又不敢太近。
lines.en: I drift up a little, but not too close.

lines.zh: 你手心里的碎屑在阳光下发亮。
lines.en: The crumbs in your hand shine in the sun.

lines.zh: 同伴先冲上去，我才跟着冲。
lines.en: My schoolmate rushes first, so I follow.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又合上，犹豫了一下。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and hesitate.

lines.zh: 那股味道太近了，我绕不开。
lines.en: The smell is too close for me to ignore.

lines.zh: 我尾巴摆得比平时快了三倍。
lines.en: My tail beats three times faster than usual.

lines.zh: 你们人类总用食物说话。
lines.en: You humans always speak with food.

lines.zh: 我咬了一小口，立刻退开。
lines.en: I take one small bite and retreat at once.

lines.zh: 水下有东西在抢，我得快点。
lines.en: Something down here is competing; I must hurry.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞散了我们整群。
lines.en: You step into the water and scatter my school.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，又立刻分开。
lines.en: We bump together, then break apart at once.

lines.zh: 我的身体太软，撞你像撞墙。
lines.en: I am so soft, hitting you is like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 那条同伴挤了我一下，我让开了。
lines.en: A schoolmate jostles me and I give way.

lines.zh: 我在你的靴子边打了个转。
lines.en: I turn in a small circle by your boot.

lines.zh: 你一脚就把我们六条冲散。
lines.en: One step of yours scatters our six.

lines.zh: 别踩，我们只有一指长。
lines.en: Watch your step; we are only a finger long.

lines.zh: 六条一起，拐个弯就散。
lines.en: Six of us scatter at the first turn.

lines.zh: 我们撞得水花都翻起来了。
lines.en: We collide hard enough to turn the surface over.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，鱼群才敢回来。
lines.en: You step back before the school dares return.

lines.zh: 我擦过海草，鳞片掉了一片。
lines.en: I brush the kelp and lose a scale.

lines.zh: 撞到我的时候，我几乎感觉不到疼。
lines.en: When you hit me, I barely feel the pain.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，把银肚子亮出来。
lines.en: I circle it and show my silver belly.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，尾巴几乎同步。
lines.en: We swim side by side, our tails in step.

lines.zh: 它认了我，鱼群就不赶我了。
lines.en: It accepts me, and the school stops crowding me.

lines.zh: 水里的光正好，我把鳍张开了。
lines.en: The light is right, so I spread my fins.

lines.zh: 六条鱼里，我只追这一条。
lines.en: Of the six, I chase only this one.

lines.zh: 我们贴着游，像同一片银箔。
lines.en: We swim pressed together, one sheet of silver.

lines.zh: 它游一圈，我就跟一圈。
lines.en: It makes a loop, and I make one too.

lines.zh: 巢在哪都行，只要水够暖。
lines.en: Any nest will do, as long as the water is warm.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的那面转向它。
lines.en: I turn my brightest side toward it.

lines.zh: 别的鱼看着，我们不管。
lines.en: The other fish watch us, and we do not care.

lines.zh: 桶一扣下来，整片水都黑了。
lines.en: The bucket comes down and the water goes black.

lines.zh: 我被兜起来，尾巴拍着桶壁。
lines.en: I am scooped up, tail slapping the tin wall.

lines.zh: 这里没有洋流，我游不动。
lines.en: There is no current here for me to swim in.

lines.zh: 隔着桶，你的脸被压得变了形。
lines.en: Through the tin your face is squeezed out of shape.

lines.zh: 我们六条挤在一起，还算热闹。
lines.en: All six of us crowd together, which is not so bad.

lines.zh: 我试着往上跳，撞到了盖子。
lines.en: I try to leap up and hit the lid.

lines.zh: 你把我提起来，水在晃。
lines.en: You lift me and the water sloshes.

lines.zh: 带我回去，记得换水。
lines.en: If you take me home, change the water.

lines.zh: 桶里的天空是圆的。
lines.en: The sky from inside this bucket is round.

lines.zh: 我贴着你提桶的手在游。
lines.en: I swim against the hand that carries the bucket.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里动，我盯住它。
lines.en: Something moves in the water, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 是跳进水里的虫子，不是鱼。
lines.en: A bug has fallen in, not a fish.

lines.zh: 同伴都转向那边，我也转过去。
lines.en: The school turns that way, so I turn too.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那只漂着的碎叶。
lines.en: I have picked out the drifting leaf fragment.

lines.zh: 有影子靠近水草，我压低了身。
lines.en: A shadow nears the weeds and I sink lower.

lines.zh: 目标很小，但我看得见。
lines.en: The target is tiny, but I can see it.

lines.zh: 我们不追大的，只追能吞下的。
lines.en: We chase nothing big, only what we can swallow.

lines.zh: 水纹一变，我立刻认清方向。
lines.en: The ripples shift and I know the direction.

lines.zh: 那东西在挣扎，水花全乱了。
lines.en: It thrashes, and the surface breaks into noise.

lines.zh: 我游在最前面，这次由我来。
lines.en: I swim at the front; this time it is mine.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转圈，先看清再动。
lines.en: I circle it first, looking before I strike.

lines.zh: 我们围成一个越来越小的圈。
lines.en: We close into a circle that keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 它往左，我就先到左边等着。
lines.en: It goes left, so I reach the left first.

lines.zh: 我压着尾巴不动，等它靠近。
lines.en: I hold my tail still and wait for it.

lines.zh: 水里的味道越来越浓了。
lines.en: The scent in the water is getting stronger.

lines.zh: 同伴在另一侧堵着，它跑不掉。
lines.en: A schoolmate blocks the other side; it cannot flee.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的鳃，那里动得最快。
lines.en: I watch its gills, the part that moves fastest.

lines.zh: 鱼群转向，一起压过去。
lines.en: The school turns as one and presses in.

lines.zh: 我们只是围着，不急着咬。
lines.en: We only circle, in no hurry to bite.

lines.zh: 它喘得越快，我就越确定。
lines.en: The faster it panics, the more certain I am.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，只撕下一点点。
lines.en: I bite and tear away only a little.

lines.zh: 嘴太小，我咬不穿它的壳。
lines.en: My mouth is too small to crack its shell.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，然后立刻退开。
lines.en: I strike, then pull back at once.

lines.zh: 我们六条一起咬，它撑不住。
lines.en: Six of us bite together and it gives way.

lines.zh: 水花一炸，我嘴里全是沙。
lines.en: The water bursts and my mouth fills with sand.

lines.zh: 我只咬得到它最软的地方。
lines.en: I can only bite the softest part of it.

lines.zh: 它甩了一下，把我甩出半格。
lines.en: It thrashes and throws me back half a block.

lines.zh: 我咬完就跑，这是规矩。
lines.en: I bite and flee; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 一条鱼的力量，就这么点。
lines.en: The strength of one small fish, that is all.

lines.zh: 我们轮流咬，它总会累。
lines.en: We take turns biting until it tires.

lines.zh: 我在一片阳光照到的浅海里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in shallow water the sun can reach.

lines.zh: 水很暖，身边已经有五条同伴。
lines.en: The water is warm and five schoolmates are already here.

lines.zh: 我第一个动，它们跟着动。
lines.en: I move first, and they move after me.

lines.zh: 上面没有船，今天很安全。
lines.en: No boat above us; today is safe.

lines.zh: 我们从珊瑚的影子底下游出来。
lines.en: We swim out from beneath the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 我刚生下来就认得队伍的方向。
lines.en: Born just now, and I already know the school's heading.

lines.zh: 海面在我头顶很高很高。
lines.en: The surface is very high above my head.

lines.zh: 沙子上有一道新的光。
lines.en: A new line of light lies on the sand.

lines.zh: 我们一群六条，谁也不少。
lines.en: Six of us in the school, not one missing.

lines.zh: 我把第一口水吐出去，算是开始。
lines.en: I spit out my first mouthful of water to begin.

lines.zh: 水在发烫，我贴在沙上不敢动。
lines.en: The water scalds and I press to the sand.

lines.zh: 我在掉落，空气比水干得可怕。
lines.en: I am falling; air is far drier than water.

lines.zh: 我在水里却喘不上气，真怪。
lines.en: I am underwater yet cannot breathe; strange.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，整片海都推了我一下。
lines.en: A muffled boom shoves the whole sea at me.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面，擦掉我半边鳞。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the water and takes half my scales.

lines.zh: 蓝色的光缠住我，我游不动了。
lines.en: Blue light coils around me and I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 我饿得发晕，连鱼群都跟不上。
lines.en: Hunger blurs my sight and I fall behind the school.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我的骨头都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 下面没有水了，我一直在往下掉。
lines.en: The water ends below and I keep falling.
